% Fixture: scanned
% An image-only PDF with no text layer, like a scan of a printed paper.
% scripts/build-fixtures.mjs first rasterises pages 1-2 of one-column.pdf to
% 1-bit PNGs at 150 dpi (scan-p1.png, scan-p2.png in the build directory);
% this document places each image on an A4 page, rotated by a fraction of a
% degree to imitate a slightly skewed scan. No fonts, no text.
\documentclass{article}
\input{fixture-common}
\usepackage[a4paper,margin=0pt]{geometry}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{tikz}
\pagestyle{empty}

\newcommand{\scanpage}[2]{%
  \null
  \begin{tikzpicture}[remember picture,overlay]
    \node[inner sep=0pt,rotate=#2] at (current page.center)
      {\includegraphics[width=\paperwidth,height=\paperheight]{#1}};
  \end{tikzpicture}%
  \clearpage}

\begin{document}
\scanpage{scan-p1}{0.4}
\scanpage{scan-p2}{-0.3}
\end{document}
